name: GALFA-Dw3 (Hubble)
blurb: GALFA-Dw3, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: galfadw3-hubble
story: A small, gas-rich galaxy found through its link to a compact cloud of hydrogen, with no confirmed neighbors nearby. Its stars tell of a burst of star formation that recently died down across the whole dwarf, while glowing HII regions still cradle young star clusters.

claims.text: GALFA-Dw3 is classified as a dwarf irregular galaxy
GALFA-Dw3 is isolated, with no confirmed neighbors nearby
GALFA-Dw3 is a gas-rich dwarf found through its association with a compact HI (hydrogen) high velocity cloud
It contains HII regions with young star clusters
A burst of star formation recently ceased across the whole dwarf
